claims.statement: The prologue is a narrative act: `event.start` establishes the run and changes no state, so reading it late costs drift rather than a refusal.
The boot narration says engine version, phase and evolution preference are narration only and resources are never rewritten automatically, which is why nobody may act on them.
`--requirement` / `--proposal` only enter the inbox and never trigger a dispatch — a run can start with work queued and nothing running.

The nine-phase requirement walk and the coordinator's four jobs (dispatch, serial acceptance, both gates, batch boundary) are the same under guide and goal: the mode changes who decides, never what must happen.
